integrity: The asymptotic coefficients are derived from the exact finite Curie--Weiss partition sum. Numerical checks are corroborative and are not used as proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies for fixed \(n\ge2\) in the complete-graph Curie--Weiss normalization. No estimate uniform as \(n\to\infty\) and no extension to general ferromagnetic graphs is claimed.
title: Two-sector low-temperature asymptotics for finite Curie--Weiss Lee--Yang zeros
